Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Finance & Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Finance & Administrative Officer. This is a contractual position offered by AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Finance & Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Finance & Administrative Officer position. This is a single opening announced by AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly without any prior online application process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Finance & Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Finance & Administrative Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) or Master of Commerce, or a BCA/B.Sc. in Computer Science or Information Technology with three years of work experience.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Finance & Administrative Officer post is scheduled to be held on 12 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the location of the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Finance & Administrative Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided above. It contains all the detailed information.
